about: Hand decisions about MSL1 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/msl1.md, Stat blocks; decisions 6, 7 and 10); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the Adventure Book and the whole header as the card prints it
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and is kept as printed; the note says why
text        match {row}: an msh_book_text row key; 'read' a few words as the OCR gives them, 'printed' as the page prints them
also      further values of the same block: one override matches one block
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Printed F EX over 6 (printed 27): 6 is Typical's number, outside Excellent's range, and Health 42 = 6 + 10 + 6 + 20 holds on the 6, so the code is the misprint. Survey decision 6.

Printed Health: 56 and Karma: 20 (printed 27): F + A + S + E = 6 + 10 + 6 + 20 = 42 and R + I + P = 6 + 4 + 6 = 16, and every number agrees with its code, so both totals are misprints (56 and 20 are the Player Character Iceman's, printed 32). Survey decision 6.
Printed F IN over 50 (printed 30): 50 is Amazing's number, outside Incredible's range, and Health 255 = 50 + 30 + 75 + 100 holds on the 50, so the code is the misprint. Survey decision 6.

Printed S N/A over a dash (printed 30): read as 0 for the check, which Health 1020 = 10 + 10 + 0 + 1000 bears out. No rank is derived and no number is shown as printed, as MA1's robots' Karma -. Survey decision 7.

Cyclops (Clone)'s Real Name, printed 27, column 1: the page prints the nickname between two double quotes, with no space before Summers; the chain made the closing mark a single, which left the row with an odd count of double quotes (120 dpi render of PDF 28). Survey decision 10's class.

Iceman (Clone)'s Real Name, printed 27, column 2: the page prints the nickname between two double quotes, with no space before Drake; the chain paired the two marks as singles, and the book prints no single quotes of its own (120 dpi render of PDF 28). Survey decision 10's class.
